description: Bank of Canada (BOC) Governor Mark Carney (February 2008 - February 2015) is to speak. As head of the BOC's Governing Council, which controls key short term interest rates, Carney has more influence over the Canadian dollar's value than any other person. Traders scrutinize his public engagements for clues regarding future monetary policy.<BR/><BR/>His comments may determine a short-term positive or negative trend.
